points.title: 贫困童年与舞台启蒙
points.description: 卓别林出生于伦敦一个贫困的演艺家庭，父亲早逝，母亲精神问题频发。他从小在贫民窟长大，9岁时母亲被送入精神病院，卓别林和兄弟被送进贫民学校。12岁时，他加入一个儿童舞蹈团，开始了演艺生涯。17岁时加入弗雷德·卡诺的剧团，逐渐发展出自己的喜剧风格。这段经历塑造了他对社会底层人民的深刻理解和同情，也为他后来的小流浪汉形象奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Chaplin was born in London to a poor theatrical family. His father died early, and his mother suffered from mental health issues. He grew up in the slums, and at 9, his mother was institutionalized, and he and his brother were sent to a workhouse. At 12, he joined a children's dance troupe, beginning his performing career. At 17, he joined Fred Karno's troupe, developing his own comedic style. These experiences shaped his deep understanding of and sympathy for the working class, laying the foundation for his later Little Tramp character.

points.title: 好莱坞崛起
points.description: 1913年，卓别林随剧团赴美国演出，被启斯东电影公司看中，开始拍摄电影。他创造的小流浪汉形象——戴着圆顶礼帽、留着小胡子、拄着拐杖、穿着破旧礼服——迅速风靡全球。在启斯东期间，他每年拍摄35-40部短片，逐渐从演员成长为导演和编剧。1914年的《威尼斯儿童赛车记》确立了他的喜剧风格。1915年转至爱山立克公司，1916年转至互助公司，期间不断完善表演技巧，形成了独特的悲喜剧风格，将喜剧与深刻的社会批判相结合。
points.descriptionEn: In 1913, Chaplin traveled to the US with his troupe and was noticed by Keystone Studios, beginning his film career. He created his Little Tramp character—bowler hat, mustache, cane, and ill-fitting suit—which quickly became globally popular. At Keystone, he made 35-40 short films annually, evolving from actor to director and writer. 'Kid Auto Races at Venice' (1914) established his comedic style. He moved to Essanay (1915) and Mutual (1916), continuously refining his technique and developing a unique blend of comedy and social critique.

points.title: 独立制片巅峰
points.description: 1919年，卓别林与格里菲斯、道格拉斯·范朋克、玛丽·毕克馥共同创立联美公司，获得创作自主权。这一时期他创作了多部经典作品，包括《寻子遇仙记》(1919)、《淘金记》(1925)、《马戏团》(1928)和《城市之光》(1931)。1929年因《马戏团》获得奥斯卡特别奖，1936年创作有声电影《摩登时代》，首次在电影中加入对工业化和资本主义的批判。1940年拍摄《大独裁者》，直接讽刺纳粹主义，展现了他的政治立场。这一时期卓别林成为全球最具影响力的电影人之一，他的作品融合了喜剧、悲剧和社会评论，影响深远。
points.descriptionEn: In 1919, Chaplin co-founded United Artists with Griffith, Douglas Fairbanks, and Mary Pickford, gaining creative control. During this period, he created classics including 'The Kid' (1919), 'The Gold Rush' (1925), 'The Circus' (1928), and 'City Lights' (1931). He received an honorary Oscar for 'The Circus' (1929) and made 'Modern Times' (1936), his first 'talkie,' which critiqued industrialization and capitalism. In 1940, he directed 'The Great Dictator,' directly satirizing Nazism and revealing his political stance. This period established Chaplin as one of the world's most influential filmmakers, blending comedy, tragedy, and social commentary.

points.title: 流亡岁月与回归
points.description: 1952年，卓别林因政治立场问题被美国政府拒绝入境，被迫移居瑞士沃韦。在瑞士期间，他创作了《舞台生涯》(1952)、《一个国王在纽约》(1957)和《香港女伯爵》(1966)等作品，但反响不如从前。1972年，卓别林获美国政府特批重返美国，接受奥斯卡荣誉奖，发表感人演讲。他在瑞士度过了晚年，继续创作和作曲，回忆录出版于1964年。这段流亡经历反映了美国麦卡锡主义时期对艺术家的迫害，也展现了卓别林坚持原则的勇气。
points.descriptionEn: In 1952, Chaplin was denied re-entry to the US due to his political views and moved to Vevey, Switzerland. There, he created 'Limelight' (1952), 'A King in New York' (1957), and 'A Countess from Hong Kong' (1966), but these received less acclaim. In 1972, he was granted special permission to return to the US to receive an honorary Oscar, delivering an emotional speech. He spent his晚年 in Switzerland, continuing to write and compose, publishing his autobiography in 1964. This exile reflected the persecution of artists during the McCarthy era and demonstrated Chaplin's courage in standing by his principles.

points.title: 晚年荣誉与遗产
points.description: 1972年，卓别林重返美国接受奥斯卡荣誉奖，获得全球影迷热烈欢迎。1975年，英国女王伊丽莎白二世授予他爵士头衔。1977年12月25日，卓别林在瑞士沃韦逝世，享年88岁。他的葬礼在瑞士举行，骨灰埋葬在沃韦公墓。卓别林一生创作了80多部影片，影响了无数后来的电影人，包括伯格曼、费里尼和黑泽明。他的小流浪汉形象成为世界文化符号，代表着对不公的抗争和对人性的坚持。卓别林的遗产不仅在于电影艺术，更在于他对社会正义的持续关注和对人类尊严的捍卫。
points.descriptionEn: In 1972, Chaplin returned to the US to receive an honorary Oscar, greeted with enthusiasm by fans worldwide. In 1975, Queen Elizabeth II knighted him. On December 25, 1977, Chaplin died in Vevey, Switzerland, at age 88. His funeral was held in Switzerland, with his ashes buried in the Corsier-sur-Vevey cemetery. Chaplin created over 80 films, influencing countless filmmakers including Bergman, Fellini, and Kurosawa. His Little Tramp became a global cultural symbol representing resistance to injustice and commitment to human dignity. His legacy extends beyond film to his lifelong concern for social justice and defense of human dignity.

supporter.zh: 卓别林被影迷和电影史学家誉为电影艺术的奠基人之一，他的小流浪汉形象成为永恒的文化符号。支持者认为卓别林通过喜剧形式深刻揭示了社会不公和人性弱点，将娱乐性与社会批判完美结合。他的作品跨越语言和文化障碍，成为真正的国际艺术语言。卓别林坚持艺术独立性和创作自由，拒绝被商业利益左右，这种艺术家的纯粹精神至今仍被推崇。他对弱势群体的同情和对社会正义的坚持，使他的作品具有超越时代的价值。
supporter.en: Chaplin is revered by film enthusiasts and historians as one of the pioneers of cinema. His Little Tramp character is considered an eternal cultural symbol. Supporters argue that Chaplin masterfully revealed social injustice and human weaknesses through comedy, perfectly blending entertainment with social critique. His work transcended linguistic and cultural barriers, becoming a truly international artistic language. Chaplin's insistence on artistic independence and creative freedom, resisting commercial pressures, is still admired today. His sympathy for the underprivileged and commitment to social justice give his works timeless value.

critic.zh: 批评者指出卓别林的早期作品存在性别歧视和对种族刻板印象的描绘，如《淘金记》中对华人矿工的丑化。他的政治立场也备受争议，被指责为亲共或反美。卓别林在处理个人生活方面也受到批评，包括多次离婚和与未成年女演员乔安娜·伍德沃德的关系。此外，批评者认为他的后期作品缺乏创新，重复早期风格，未能适应电影艺术的发展。他的独断专行和自我中心也被认为是其艺术生涯中的缺陷。
critic.en: Critics point out that Chaplin's early works contained gender discrimination and racial stereotypes, such as the caricature of Chinese miners in 'The Gold Rush.' His political stance was also controversial, with accusations of being pro-communist or anti-American. Chaplin's personal life was criticized, including multiple divorces and his relationship with underage actress Joanna Woodward. Additionally, critics argue his later works lacked innovation, repeating his early style without adapting to the evolution of cinema. His autocratic and self-centered nature is seen as a flaw in his artistic career.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，卓别林被定义为电影史上最具影响力的先驱之一，他的艺术成就超越了单纯的喜剧范畴。他的小流浪汉形象已成为全球文化符号，代表着对不公的抗争和对人性的坚持。卓别林的作品反映了20世纪上半叶的社会变迁，从工业革命到世界大战，从经济大萧条到政治极权主义。他的电影语言影响了无数后世导演，成为默片时代的巅峰。尽管他的政治立场和个人生活存在争议，但他在电影艺术上的创新和贡献是不可否认的，他被公认为电影史上最伟大的艺术家之一。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Chaplin is recognized as one of the most influential pioneers in film history, whose artistic achievements transcend mere comedy. His Little Tramp character has become a global cultural symbol representing resistance to injustice and commitment to human dignity. Chaplin's work reflects the social changes of the first half of the 20th century, from industrialization to world wars, from the Great Depression to political totalitarianism. His cinematic language has influenced countless directors, representing the pinnacle of the silent film era. Despite controversies over his political views and personal life, his innovations and contributions to film are undeniable, establishing him as one of the greatest artists in cinema history.

self.zh: 生活是一场悲剧，但对我来说，喜剧是面对悲剧的方式。
self.en: Life is a tragedy when seen in close-up, but a comedy in long-shot.

others.zh: 卓别林不需要台词，他的表情就是整个世界。
others.en: Chaplin doesn't need dialogue; his face is the whole world.
